areas.name: Sydney Coast: Broken Bay to Port Hacking

periods.label: Monday 2 Nov
periods.winds: Northeasterly about 10 knots increasing to 15 to 20 knots in the middle of the day.
periods.seas: Below 0.5 metres, increasing to around 1 metre around midday.

periods.label: Tuesday 3 Nov
periods.winds: North to northeasterly 15 to 20 knots shifting south to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the evening. Squalls possible with the wind change.

periods.swell1: Northeasterly below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 2 metres during the morning.
periods.weather: Partly cloudy. 90% chance of showers. A thunderstorm likely.

periods.label: Wednesday 4 Nov
periods.winds: South to southwesterly 15 to 20 knots tending south to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots during the afternoon then becoming variable below 10 knots during the evening.
periods.seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing below 1 metre during the afternoon or evening.
periods.swell1: Northeasterly 1 to 2 metres, decreasing to around 1 metre during the morning.
periods.swell2: Southerly around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the morning.
periods.weather: Partly cloudy. 50% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm.

areas.name: Sydney Enclosed Waters
areas.synoptic: A ridge extends over the Sydney waters. A trough will move north across the Sydney waters late on Tuesday, followed by a new trough late on Wednesday. A new ridge will extend over the Sydney waters on Thursday.
